svg.text: A unified Python API for analysis codes, surrogate models, and integration frameworks
pip install standard-evaluator | Python 3.9+ | Apache 2.0 License | Partially developed under NASA Contract 80GRC023CA045
Unified interface for all analysis codes
All evaluators support: DataFrame I/O | eval_np | eval_list | SQLite Caching | Logging | Finite-Difference Gradients
+ Test Evaluators: Rosenbrock, Sphere, Cantilevered Beam and more benchmark problems
• Bounds, shift, scale on each variable
Framework Independence | Serializable Everything | Evaluator Composability | Rolled/Unrolled Duality | Options-Driven Configuration
